title: How Early Is Early Enough? Design-Dependent Observation-Window Sufficiency in Subscription Churn Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2607.00473v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: How many days of early behavior suffice for subscription churn prediction? In the public KKBox dataset, the early indicator of churn is typically an indicator of someone's contract status; however, when looking in the heavily churned manual-renewal segment, having access to early behavior creates a substantial increase in prediction for that specific segment (PR +0.10 at 120 days). A nine-window sufficiency curve shows diminishing returns; descriptive inflection detectors place a knee between 30 and 120 days depending on the metric and model class. Stress-testing over three cohort/task designs shows that this curve is singular to the design being tested; for example, in our test with a moving target, the curve inverts and can shift depending on the feature set used. Therefore, any window-sufficiency claim should state its cohort construction, target definition, and feature families. A survival-filtered replication on educational-attr

translated_title: 多早才算够早？订阅流失预测中依赖研究设计的观察窗口充分性
translated_abstract: 多少天的早期行为数据足以用于订阅流失预测？在公开的KKBox数据集中，流失的早期指标通常是用户合同状态的指示器；然而，当关注流失率较高的手动续订用户群体时，获取早期行为数据能为这一特定细分群体带来显著的预测提升（120天时PR提升0.10）。九个观察窗口的充分性曲线显示出收益递减；描述性拐点检测器根据所用指标和模型类的不同，将拐点置于30至120天之间。针对三种队列/任务设计的压力测试表明，该曲线仅对所测试的设计具有唯一性；例如，在移动目标的测试中，曲线会发生反转，并可能随所用特征集而移动。因此，任何关于窗口充分性的论断都应明确说明其队列构建方式、目标定义和特征族。基于教育流失数据、经生存过滤的复制实验……
tldr: 该研究发现订阅流失预测所需的早期观察窗口长度高度依赖研究设计——在不同队列构建、目标定义和特征集下，窗口充分性曲线差异巨大甚至可能反转，因此任何关于窗口充分性的结论都必须明确说明其设计选择。
en_tdlr: Observation-window sufficiency in subscription churn prediction is design-dependent—gains from early behavior vary substantially (and can even invert) across cohort constructions, target definitions, and feature sets—so any window-sufficiency claim must explicitly state its design choices.
